sentences.text: P0 INC-88: Northstar Bank card payments failing since 07:40; route B restores about 78% success, and Northstar only promises a fix "this afternoon".
Palmway's CFO wants a root cause and fix date by end of day tomorrow; Karim's PAY-398 fix needs a prod slot before tonight's 21:00 settlement run.
Three pre-freeze items are stuck: PR #318 waits on Layla (out until Thursday), PAY-412 waits on our reply to KYCly, and Arjun's PAY-405, which also holds ONB-81, waits on infra's staging credentials.
KYC v2 (PR #316, ONB-64) shipped to production at 08:15 today.
Two decisions wait on you before Thursday's 11:00 freeze: ONB-77 scope versus the CEO's 3pm demo, and your review of PR #322, pending since Monday 13:30.
